Tucson, Arizona · stay

Hotels in Tucson for cyclists

Where to sleep in Tucson when you’re here to ride. Book early for event weekends.

For: El Tour de Tucson.

Hotels in Tucson for cyclists, listed

1 with a bike policy in writing · 5 to ask.

  1. The Tuxon

    • 960 S Freeway Road, Tucson, AZ 85745
    • $$
    • Bike: Free storage for your own bike, per the hotel’s About page. It doesn’t say where, or that the bike can go in the room.
    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about The Tuxon

    West of downtown by the Santa Cruz: the Loop is two blocks from the door by the hotel’s own page, and the convention center, where El Tour starts, is about 0.7 mile by Kayak’s map. The one hotel we found with a line about your own bike in writing. Free cruisers from its Bike Shed, free parking, a pool and a 24-hour gym; IHG books it as voco The Tuxon. From $127 a night on Kayak (Oct 3, 2026); El Tour’s 2026 room block was $159.

  2. Hotel McCoy

    Southwest of downtown: a motor lodge on one level with room-front parking (Hotels.com), so the bike goes from the car to the room with no stairs.

    • 720 West Silverlake Road, Tucson, AZ 85713
    • $
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Hotel McCoy

    The Santa Cruz River Park path, part of the Loop, is about a 10-minute walk by the same listing, and the convention center about 1.4 miles by Kayak’s. Free breakfast 6 to 10 a.m., early enough for a ride-out; heated saltwater pool, free parking, dogs stay free. $80 a night before tax for Oct 11, 2026 (Hotels.com). Nothing on its own page about your own bike.

  3. DoubleTree by Hilton Tucson Downtown Convention Center

    Downtown, about 0.1 mile from the convention center, where El Tour starts and finishes (Kayak and Tripadvisor): the closest bed to the start.

    • 280 S Church Ave, Tucson, AZ 85701
    • $$$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about DoubleTree by Hilton Tucson Downtown Convention Center

    Outdoor pool and an elevator; self-parking $24 a night, valet $30. $150 a night for Oct 19, 2026, taxes in (Expedia); from $207 on Kayak (Oct 3, 2026). The facts here are from the booking sites; check the hotel’s own page.

  4. The Leo Kent Hotel

    Downtown, about 0.2 mile from the convention center (Kayak).

    • 1 South Church Avenue, Tucson, AZ 85701
    • $$$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about The Leo Kent Hotel

    A Marriott Tribute Portfolio hotel with a gym and an elevator; self-parking $32 a day, valet $39. $175 for Oct 11, 2026, taxes in (Expedia), and from $272 on Kayak (Oct 3, 2026); El Tour’s 2026 room block was $235. The highest rate here.

  5. AC Hotel by Marriott Tucson Downtown

    On Broadway downtown, about 0.4 mile from the convention center (Kayak), on the same block as Pueblo Vida Brewing.

    • 151 E Broadway Blvd, Tucson, AZ 85701
    • $$$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about AC Hotel by Marriott Tucson Downtown

    From $211 a night on Kayak (Oct 3, 2026); El Tour’s 2026 room block was $214. The facts here are from Kayak and El Tour’s list, the thinnest record of the six; check the hotel’s own page.

  6. Hotel Congress

    The historic hotel downtown, about 0.5 mile from the convention center (Kayak).

    • 311 E Congress St, Tucson, AZ 85701
    • $$$
    • Bike: No stated policy. Ask when you book.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Hotel Congress

    Where you stay for the town, not for the sleep. The rooms are upstairs: Visit Tucson lists 39 second-floor rooms, so ask about stairs and an elevator before you carry a bike up. The Cup Café, a tap room and Club Congress are downstairs. Visit Tucson mentions the rumble of passing trains: lively, not quiet. From $186 on Trivago and $213 on Kayak (Oct 2026).
